title: ESTHER TO BRING BREAKFAST TO STATE STREET - NewsBreak
text: 2 days ago I recently attended a friends and family night for Esther, a breakfast house coming to 1213 State Street, the former home of Bibi Ji and McDonald’s. Esther comes from the team behind Beau, the “storytelling bar” at 1129A State Street: Starr Hall, Bruce Rolla and Barbara McDaniel. Both establishments are based on a book series Hall wrote with Rolla’s help, featuring characters from the 1920s. “Esther’s a time traveler,” Hall told me. “This is going to be very much a time travel concept in here.” The first book in the series, The Beau Chronicles, is due out from a major publisher in the first quarter of next year. Hall says she can’t name the publisher yet. She plans to plant clues throughout the restaurant so diners can help solve the mysteries in the series. The pink décor from the Bibi Ji days is on its way out. Read full article
